items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She says, 'I talked to the Governor yesterday. Said he came out and saw you play. Said you sounded great.'

ctx.x: PCC. Mr. [?Bernoas]. I kept trying to write this stuff, and he, “This – we’re not studying this. I can’t give you a passing grade.” All of a sudden, Billy calls me up from New York. He says, “We got two weeks at Birdland. Would you like to come?” I said, “I certainly would.” I said, “Let me talk to my mom.” I said, “Mom, is it okay if I leave school and go play at Birdland in New York City?” She says, “Of course.” Now, my mother – my mom, she been on the phone ever since the thing at school. She been calling. She…
You guys didn’t get too far.
